data.narrative:
Rebellions is a Series A-stage semiconductor chip company currently valued at $2.34B post-money, having raised $850M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 11 private peers in the chips and semiconductors sector (including SambaNova Systems, d-Matrix, Cerebras, and others) and three public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression modeling applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the current $2.3B post-money valuation, implying a $4.7B value at the next funding stage. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $1.0B (Positron AI, Series B) to $11.0B (SambaNova Systems, Series A). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (median 20.5x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied, as Rebellions' revenue is not on file. This limitation is typical for early-stage private semiconductor companies.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.7B (low) to $5.4B (high), with a median of $3.3B. The current $2.34B valuation sits in the lower half of this band, reflecting modest discount to the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the peer set ($1.0B–$11.0B), the lack of revenue visibility for revenue-multiple anchoring, and the volatile stage dynamics within Series A in frontier chip development.
